_about: Server profiles for the TV app's tests, laid over the Windows app's fake Jellyfin server (tvserver.py). version: what /System/Info answers. auth: the desktop server's token rules, strict (Jellyfin 12: only 'Authorization: MediaBrowser Token=...' and ApiKey) or legacy (10.x: X-Emby-*, api_key too). getInitiate: whether GET /QuickConnect/Initiate still works (12 removed it). oneTokenPerDeviceId: a sign-in revokes the earlier token of the same DeviceId, as the SDK maintainer describes the server.

jellyfin-12.use: The default. What the official TV client calls 'works best'.

jellyfin-10.11.use: Below the 12.0 minimum: not supported, Connect anyway in the app. Only this folder's tests use it.

jellyfin-10.10.use: Below the 12.0 minimum, like jellyfin-10.11. Only this folder's tests use it.
